title: Information Representation Fairness in Long-Document Embeddings: The Peculiar Interaction of Positional and Language Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Using a permutation-based evaluation framework to vary the order of segments in long documents, then measuring the cosine similarity between the standalone segment embeddings and the global document embedding to quantify the over-representation of early-positioned segments.

Constructing mixed-language documents from a multilingual comparable corpus (Wikipedia articles in six languages) and evaluating how a segment's source language affects its representational weight in the global document embedding, controlling for position.
